request: Feature 3 of 4: per-range performance chips - each chart range button shows what that window did, from data the app already holds (no new network traffic). Ship only when proven and nothing else broke. Checkpoint frequently - usage may run out.

now.next: Round 62 open: per-range performance chips. Work the ladder T0->T8.

tasks.title: Baseline: v7.2 tree builds and 411 tests green before any edit
tasks.note: 416/416 green on the untouched v7.2 tree (Gradle + SDK restored on a cold container)

tasks.title: Design: chip figures mirror the drawn chart exactly, cached-only, zero new requests
tasks.note: chips show the SAME figure the chart readout shows for that window - same series, same baseline, same live edge - and only for ranges already held. No chip ever starts a fetch: the disk read in loadChart already publishes every cached range for the symbol in one query, so this feature is free

tasks.title: Pure model: a total function for what each chip shows
tasks.note: rangePct + rangeFigure: total, no allocation, negative zero normalised

tasks.title: RangeChips UI: two-line chip, sign colour, 48dp rule, contentDescription
tasks.note: two-line chip: label over figure, sign colour off the selected chip, nbsp keeps every chip the same height

tasks.title: Wire DetailScreen: per-range live edge, loading state, no extra fetches
tasks.note: DetailScreen builds chartPerf/chartLoadingRanges from the map it already collects; compiles clean

tasks.title: Tests: pure + rendered, incl. chip equals readout and no-new-request proof
tasks.note: RangeChipTest (13 pure) + RangeChipUiTest (9 rendered, incl. chip-equals-readout with the live edge)

tasks.title: REGRESSION: full suite, lint, checkinit; prove chart and the rest unchanged
tasks.note: 440/440 green, lint vital clean, checkinit ok; the only pre-existing test touched is ChartUiTest's chip loop, which now scrolls as a finger would

tasks.title: Adversarial review of the feature, then fix what it finds
Only if all clean: ship v7.3 (versionCode 60) + checkpoint
